scope: offline research probe; upstream-neutral periodic net-return checker

required_fields.timestamps: one explicit UTC ISO 8601 valuation timestamp per return
required_fields.expected_calendar: complete explicit UTC valuation timestamp sequence supplied by owner
required_fields.net_returns: decimal fraction of full-account net NAV change, after actual costs and flows; 0.01 means 1%
required_fields.reference_returns: matched decimal fraction per valuation period
required_fields.periods_per_year: positive integer for conventional sqrt annualization
required_fields.provenance: nonempty JSON-compatible mapping with string keys, recursively copied into immutable result; caller eligibility claims have no authority
required_fields.marks_complete: literal true only when all period valuations have accepted marks
required_fields.costs_complete: literal true only when all applicable costs have accepted evidence
required_fields.flows_reconciled: literal true only when external flows have accepted reconciliation
required_fields.timing_verified: literal true only when decision, trade and valuation timing is accepted

output.diagnostics: private synthetic formula checks only: excess mean, sample variance/SD, conventional mean/SD Sharpe and sqrt(periods_per_year) scaling

limitations: No ledger adapter, eligibility decision, or production integration.
No calendar inference, row deletion, missing-value imputation, or source validation.
No HAC, bootstrap, Monte Carlo, calibration, or 95% confidence interval.
No user-facing economic Sharpe, trading-readiness, or profitability claim.
A validated shape alone cannot establish accepted costs, marks, timing, provenance, or an untouched holdout.
